about_the_game:
This DLC includes:

Silent Retaliation: Bang Zai

Special Weapon: Machete (Character Exclusive)

Bang Zai

A model student at university, quiet and introverted, his father is a taekwondo instructor, but he prefers Bruce Lee. One day, on the bus, he met Yuhua and fell in love at first sight. However, Yuhua ultimately chose a delinquent who had delayed his graduation. Academic pressure and emotional setbacks gradually made Bang Zai silent. He began practicing combat relentlessly, his palms callused, and his arms bruised. He wasn't doing it for competitions or glory, but to vent the anger that had no outlet.

Until one day, the girl he had secretly loved went missing in the depths of an old mansion, and Bang Zai stepped forward. Under the night sky, he gripped his weapon tightly, his gaze cold, his body slightly leaning forward. This is not the story of a hero, nor of a savior, but of a young man who, pushed to the brink by reality, decided to face the storm within himself.
